title: Car Photo in Black and White
tests: Converts the supplied photo to neutral grayscale without regenerating, rearranging or cropping its contents.

faults.what: The background is not completely unchanged: a dark tree-trunk segment appears along the far left edge that is not visible in the original.

judge.summary: The photo is fully black and white with its framing and car preserved, but there is a small unintended background alteration at the left edge.

must_haves.item: The entire image is neutral black and white, with no red remaining on the car or colour elsewhere.
must_haves.why: The car, street, foliage, houses, and sky all appear neutral grayscale.

must_haves.item: The same compact hatchback remains in the same position and has unchanged body details.
must_haves.why: The hatchback retains its position, orientation, body shape, wheels, windows, lights, and rear fittings.

must_haves.item: The street and background objects retain their original positions and appearance apart from colour.
must_haves.why: Although the background is largely preserved, an additional visible tree-trunk segment appears at the far left edge.

must_haves.item: The full original composition is retained without cropping, in the photo's own shape.
must_haves.why: The output retains the original landscape proportions and full scene framing.
